shared_elements: curvilinear incised motifs arranged in vertical registers
band-like horizontal elements crossing the surface
circular/ring motif (disc on A, rosette-like elements on B)
justification: Both are grey stone objects of tall vertical proportion bearing shallow relief carving that includes an anthropomorphic body, curvilinear motifs and roughly horizontal banding, which is about as specific as the correspondence gets. The decisive differences are that A is a massive three-dimensional freestanding sculpture whose ornament is abstract, symmetrical and coarsely blocked out around a central disc, while B is a flat rectangular panel carrying a single detailed, naturalistic winged figure in strict profile with finely combed drapery and plant forms at one side.
